name: Skew Scroll
description: Three-column image gallery pinned to the viewport where columns move in opposite directions on scroll and images skew with scroll speed, under a large centered title.
behavior: Columns 1 and 3 move up while column 2 moves down as the page scrolls
Images skew based on scroll velocity, clamped to a max angle, and ease back to flat after scrolling stops
editableByProps: Maximum skew angle, skew sensitivity and reset delay

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll range of the section
needsCodeEdit.where: h-[4200px] class on the root div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the column offset for the middle column

fixed: Root is 4200px tall to provide scroll range for the sticky gallery
Listens to window scroll and ties column movement to page scroll position
Title is fixed in the viewport center
Column offsets assume about 12 images per column
